verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent-tracing product records conversations, LLM calls, token cost, tool calls and errors, so output scoring is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions evaluators, LLM-as-a-judge scoring or configurable eval criteria. Replay, monitoring and dashboards are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
